_doc: Applied at route time (no resync needed). Keys: 'provider:*', 'provider:model', 'provider:model:effort'; more specific keys win per field. Fields: exclude, max_floor, allowed_roles, floor_constraints{floor:{min_verifiability,allowed_categories,max_blast_radius}}, quality_bias (number or {role:number}, in index points), cost_multiplier. Machine/plan-specific entries go in overrides.local.json.

cursor:grok-4.7.notes: Never above R1, and at R1 only for strictly gated low-blast work. With AA index ~31–35 it currently clears only R0 floors; a positive quality_bias in overrides.local.json would admit it to the constrained R1 slot.

cursor:grok-4.7:xhigh.notes: Marginal +0.3 index over high at higher latency/cost.
